items.name: Roasted Brussels sprouts
items.preparation: roasted or pan-browned whole and halved sprouts with charred outer leaves

items.name: Cooking oil (olive/vegetable) used for roasting
items.preparation: tossed in oil before roasting; the glossy, browned surfaces suggest oil was used

scale_cues: I used the white square plate, about 25–27 cm across, and the size of each sprout against it (about 2.5–3.5 cm each, roughly 18 pieces). I also used the wooden mounting strip and the screws on the scale platform as a reference.
assumptions: About 18 sprouts or sprout pieces at roughly 7–8 g each after cooking
Roasted sprouts without oil are counted at about 50 kcal and 3.4 g protein per 100 g
The amount of oil is inferred from the browning and glossy surface, and no oil is pooled on the plate
No salt or seasoning was counted because it adds almost no calories
The yellowish color is likely browning or a light glaze, not cheese or a sweet sauce
